name: Altstadt Kufstein
kurzbeschreibung: The historic old town of **Kufstein**, with its charming alleys and romantic town square, invites you to take a leisurely stroll.
beschreibung: Kufstein Old Town – Culture enthusiasts will find plenty to enjoy in **Kufstein Old Town**: This historic old town, with its charming alleys and romantic town square, invites you to take a leisurely stroll—whether you're alone, with family, or in a group. **Kufstein Old Town** offers a rich cultural experience for all ages. Audioguides and informative panels allow you to explore at your own pace. Located right in the heart of **Kufstein**, it’s easily accessible on foot or by public transport. Its central location makes it the perfect starting point for a cultural walk through the city. Whether in summer or winter, **Kufstein Old Town** is always worth a visit.
